notes.subject: go itaba
notes.rationale: יחוש e bolela 'go potlaka / go phologa ka tlhoafalo'; ditirhišo tše dingwe di bolela 'go hlohleletša', tše dingwe 'go ipela' (ASV/JPS go kgahlanong le KJV 'go hlohleletša go se ntshe').

notes.subject: kwantle go tšwa go nna
notes.rationale: חוץ ממני: 'kwantle go nna' goba 'go feta nna' (KJV); mantšu a senna a fapana, gomme BSB a bala 'kwantle go Yena' (Elohim).

translation: Gobe ke mang yo a kago go ja, gomme ke mang yo a kago go itaba, kwantle go tšwa go nna?
